title: CONDICIONALES AVANZADAS
subtitle: Advanced conditionals · mixtas y alternativas a if

map.center: Mezclamos tiempos (mixed conditionals) y cambiamos if por conectores más precisos: unless, provided that, but for…

items.q: If I ____ law, I'd be a lawyer now.
____ you pay, you can't come in.
You can go ____ you're back by ten.
Take a coat ____ it gets cold.
Hurry up, ____ we'll be late.

explain.es: Las condicionales avanzadas son de dos tipos. (1) Las mixed conditionals combinan tiempos distintos en cada parte porque la condición y el resultado no pertenecen al mismo momento (una decisión del pasado con consecuencias hoy). (2) Las alternativas a if añaden matices que if no tiene: excepción (unless), requisito (provided that, as long as), hipótesis (supposing, what if), precaución (in case), consecuencia negativa (otherwise) o causa decisiva (but for).
explain.en: Advanced conditionals = mixed conditionals (condition and result belong to different times) + alternatives to if that add nuance: exception, requirement, hypothesis, precaution.
formula: If + *past simple* + would have + participio (siempre → pasado)

explain.title: 1 · Mixta: pasado → presente
explain.es: La condición es pasada e irreal (no ocurrió) y el resultado es presente: cómo están las cosas ahora. En la parte del if va past perfect; en el resultado, would / could / might + infinitivo, muchas veces con now, today, still. Es la estructura española Si hubiera…, ahora + condicional simple.
explain.en: Unreal past condition → present result: If + past perfect, would / could / might + infinitive.

examples.en: If I had accepted that offer, I would be living in California now.
examples.es: Si hubiera aceptado aquella oferta, ahora estaría viviendo en California.

examples.en: If the company had invested in digital tools, it wouldn't be struggling today.
examples.es: Si la empresa hubiera invertido en herramientas digitales, hoy no tendría dificultades.

examples.en: If you had taken the medicine, you might feel better now.
examples.es: Si te hubieras tomado la medicina, puede que ahora te encontraras mejor.

explain.title: 2 · Mixta: presente → pasado
explain.es: La condición es una situación presente o permanente que no es real (un rasgo de carácter, una capacidad, un hecho general) y el resultado es pasado. En la parte del if va past simple o past continuous (were en registro cuidado, was en el habla); en el resultado, would / could / might have + participio. En español: Si fuera…, habría…
explain.en: Unreal present / permanent condition → past result: If + past simple, would / could / might have + past participle.
formula: If + *past simple / were* + …, + *would / could / might have* + participio

examples.en: If I were more organised, I wouldn't have missed the deadline.
examples.es: Si fuera más organizado, no habría perdido el plazo.

examples.en: If she didn't speak fluent German, she wouldn't have got the job in Berlin.
examples.es: Si no hablara alemán con fluidez, no habría conseguido el trabajo en Berlín.

examples.en: If we weren't flying to Rome tomorrow, we would have accepted your invitation.
examples.es: Si no voláramos mañana a Roma, habríamos aceptado vuestra invitación.

explain.title: Las cuatro combinaciones
head: Tipo · Type
Condición (if)
Resultado
Ejemplo · Example
rows: If I had more time, I would travel more.
If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.
If I had studied law, I would be a lawyer now.
If I were a lawyer, I would have spotted the problem.
explain.note: Pregúntate por separado: ¿cuándo es la condición? ¿cuándo es el resultado? Cada mitad lleva su propio tiempo.
explain.note_en: Ask separately: when is the condition? When is the result? Each half takes its own tense.

explain.title: 3 · Unless
explain.es: Unless = if … not / a menos que, salvo que, a no ser que. Ya lleva la negación: no añadas otra (unless you don't pay). Para el futuro va con presente. Matiz: unless presenta la condición como la única excepción, así que no sustituye a if … not cuando hablamos de reacciones: I'll be surprised if he doesn't come (no unless he comes).
explain.en: Unless = if … not / except if. It is already negative. Use a present tense for the future.

examples.en: Unless we reduce costs, we will have to make redundancies.
examples.es: A menos que reduzcamos costes, tendremos que hacer despidos.

examples.en: The offer is not valid unless it is signed by both parties.
examples.es: La oferta no es válida salvo que la firmen ambas partes.

examples.en: I won't call you unless there's a problem.
examples.es: No te llamaré a no ser que haya algún problema.

explain.title: 4 · Provided that, as long as…
explain.es: Expresan un requisito: solo si, siempre que, con tal de que. Del más formal al más coloquial: on condition that (contratos, acuerdos) → provided / providing (that) → as long as / so long as. Van con presente aunque hablen del futuro (provided that you will pay). ¡Trampa! El español siempre que también significa cada vez que = whenever: Siempre que llueve, se inunda → Whenever it rains…
explain.en: On condition that (very formal) → provided / providing (that) → as long as (neutral). Present tense for the future.
formula: Resultado + *provided (that) / as long as / on condition that* + presente

examples.en: You can work from home as long as you attend the Monday meeting.
examples.es: Puedes teletrabajar siempre que asistas a la reunión de los lunes.

examples.en: The loan will be approved provided that you can show proof of income.
examples.es: El préstamo se aprobará siempre que puedas acreditar tus ingresos.

examples.en: She agreed to the interview on condition that her name was not published.
examples.es: Accedió a la entrevista con la condición de que no se publicara su nombre.

explain.title: 5 · Supposing, what if, assuming
explain.es: Para plantear hipótesis: suppose / supposing (that) (= pongamos que, imagina que), what if (= ¿y si…?), imagine y assuming (that) (= dando por hecho que). Con presente, la situación se ve posible; con pasado, más improbable o imaginaria: What if we miss the train? / What if we missed the train? Con suppose / supposing la frase suele terminar en pregunta.
explain.en: Suppose / supposing, what if, imagine, assuming introduce hypotheses. Present = possible; past = less likely or imaginary.

examples.en: Supposing you were offered a promotion abroad, would you accept it?
examples.es: Pongamos que te ofrecieran un ascenso en el extranjero, ¿lo aceptarías?

examples.en: What if the investors pull out at the last minute?
examples.es: ¿Y si los inversores se retiran en el último momento?

examples.en: Assuming the figures are correct, we will break even next year.
examples.es: Dando por hecho que las cifras son correctas, el año que viene cubriremos gastos.

explain.title: 6 · Otherwise, or else, but for
explain.es: Otherwise (= si no, de lo contrario) introduce la consecuencia negativa de no cumplir lo anterior; suele ir tras punto, punto y coma o and. Or (else) es su versión coloquial. But for + nombre (formal) = de no ser por = if it weren't / hadn't been for = without. Detrás de but for va un nombre, nunca una frase completa.
explain.en: Otherwise / or else = if not. But for + noun = if it weren't / hadn't been for = without.

examples.en: Please confirm by Friday; otherwise, your booking will be cancelled.
examples.es: Por favor, confirme antes del viernes; de lo contrario, su reserva quedará anulada.

examples.en: But for the goalkeeper's heroics, we would have lost by five goals.
examples.es: De no ser por las paradas heroicas del portero, habríamos perdido por cinco goles.

examples.en: If it hadn't been for your advice, I would have signed a terrible contract.
examples.es: Si no hubiera sido por tu consejo, habría firmado un contrato pésimo.

explain.title: 7 · In case ≠ if · even if
explain.title_en: In case, in the event of, even if
explain.es: In case = por si (acaso): hacemos algo como precaución, ocurra o no lo otro. If = si: lo hacemos solo cuando se cumple la condición. ¡Trampa! En caso de que se traduce por if o, en registro formal, por in the event that / in the event of + nombre, nunca por in case + frase (in case of + nombre sí existe en avisos: In case of fire…). Y even if (= aunque, incluso si: hipótesis) no es even though (= aunque: hecho real).
explain.en: In case = as a precaution. In the event of / that = formal if. Even if = hypothetical; even though = fact.

examples.en: Take your laptop in case the client wants a demo.
examples.es: Llévate el portátil por si el cliente quiere una demostración.

examples.en: In the event of a fire, do not use the lifts.
examples.es: En caso de incendio, no utilicen los ascensores.

examples.en: Even if they double my salary, I won't stay.
examples.es: Aunque me dupliquen el sueldo, no me quedaré.

explain.title: In case frente a if
explain.es: La diferencia es de precaución frente a condición: con in case la acción se hace ya, por si acaso; con if, solo si se cumple la condición.
explain.en: In case = precaution (do it now). If = condition (do it only when it happens).

cols.head: ☂️ in case · por si acaso
items: Take an umbrella in case it rains. (lo llevas ya)
I'll save the file in case the system crashes.
Write it down in case you forget.

cols.head: 🌧️ if · si (condición)
items: Take an umbrella if it rains. (solo si llueve)
If the system crashes, call IT.

items.es: Si el Gobierno hubiera actuado antes, la crisis no sería ahora tan grave.

items.en: If he weren't so stubborn, he would have listened to our advice.

items.en: Suppose the train is cancelled — how will we get to the conference?

items.en: Back up your files regularly; otherwise, you risk losing everything.

items.en: But for a few technical problems, the launch would have been a complete success.

items.en: I'll keep my phone on in case the hospital calls.

items.en: In the event that the flight is delayed, passengers will be offered a meal voucher.

items.en: As long as we keep our customers happy, the business will grow.

¿Y si no nos hubiéramos conocido nunca?

items.en: Even if the plan fails, we will have learnt a great deal.

items.good: If I had known, I would have helped.
items.why: Nunca would en la parte del if.

items.bad: If I had studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
Unless you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
items.good: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
items.why: Unless ya es negativo: no dobles la negación.

items.bad: Provided that you will finish on time, you'll get a bonus.
items.good: Provided that you finish on time, you'll get a bonus.
items.why: Tras provided / as long as / unless: presente.

items.bad: Take an umbrella in case it will rain.
items.good: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

items.bad: In case of the flight is cancelled, we'll get a refund.
items.good: If (In the event that) the flight is cancelled, we'll get a refund.
items.why: «En caso de que» + frase = if / in the event that.

items.bad: Supposing you will lose your job, what would you do?
items.good: Supposing you lost your job, what would you do?

items.bad: But for you helped me, I would have failed.
items.good: But for your help, I would have failed.
items.why: But for + nombre, nunca una frase.

items.es: Localiza el momento de la condición: ¿presente / permanente o pasado?
items.en: When is the condition: present / permanent or past?

items.es: Localiza el momento del resultado: ¿ahora o entonces? Busca pistas: now, today, still, yesterday, last year…
items.en: When is the result: now or then?

items.es: Pasado → ahora: If + had + participio, would + infinitivo. Siempre → pasado: If + past simple, would have + participio.
items.en: Past → now: had + pp, would + inf. Always → past: past simple, would have + pp.

items.es: ¿Quieres un matiz? Excepción → unless; requisito → provided / as long as; hipótesis → supposing / what if; precaución → in case; consecuencia negativa → otherwise.
items.en: Choose the connector for the nuance you need.

items.es: Revisa: nada de will / would tras if, unless, provided, as long as o in case (salvo peticiones corteses: If you would follow me…).
items.en: No will / would after if, unless, provided or in case (except polite requests).

lines.en: We're interested, but the price is still too high.
lines.es: Nos interesa, pero el precio sigue siendo demasiado alto.

lines.es: Sinceramente, si hubiéramos conocido esta oferta antes, ya estaríamos trabajando con ustedes.

lines.en: It's not too late. But please confirm by Friday; otherwise, we can't guarantee the price.
lines.es: No es demasiado tarde. Pero confirmen antes del viernes; si no, no podemos garantizar el precio.

lines.en: Fine. Unless the board objects, we'll sign next week.
lines.es: De acuerdo. Salvo que el consejo se oponga, firmaremos la semana que viene.

lines.en: Perfect. I'll send you the draft today in case you want to review it first.
lines.es: Perfecto. Les envío el borrador hoy, por si quieren revisarlo antes.

explain.title: Truco de los dos relojes
explain.es: Para las mixtas, dibuja dos relojes ⏰: uno para la condición y otro para el resultado. Condición ayer + resultado hoy → had + participio … would + infinitivo. Condición siempre + resultado ayer → past simple … would have + participio. En registro formal, provided that u on condition that suenan más precisos que un simple if.
explain.en: Draw two clocks: one for the condition, one for the result. Each half takes its own tense.

Take an umbrella because it might rain later. 🔑 CASE
Take an umbrella _____ later.

She's not very confident, so she didn't apply for the promotion. 🔑 MORE
If _____, she would have applied for the promotion.

Leave now or you'll miss the last bus. 🔑 OTHERWISE
Leave now; _____ the last bus.

They'll sign the contract only if we lower the price. 🔑 PROVIDED
They'll sign the contract _____ the price.

Imagine you were offered the job. Would you take it? 🔑 SUPPOSING
_____ the job, would you take it?

I'm not rich, so I didn't buy that flat. 🔑 WOULD
If I were rich, _____ that flat.

exercises.title: Traduce al inglés
exercises.es: Traduce al inglés. Piensa en el momento de cada parte y en el conector más preciso.

items.q: Si hubiera estudiado Medicina, ahora sería médico.
items.a: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.

items.q: Si no fuera tan tímida, habría hablado en la reunión.
items.a: If she weren't (wasn't) so shy, she would have spoken at the meeting.

items.q: A menos que lleguemos a un acuerdo, iremos a juicio.
items.a: Unless we reach an agreement, we will go to court.

items.q: Puedes usar el coche siempre que me lo devuelvas con el depósito lleno.
items.a: You can use the car as long as (provided that) you give it back with a full tank.

items.q: Llévate el portátil por si el cliente quiere ver la presentación.
items.a: Take your laptop in case the client wants to see the presentation.

items.q: En caso de que haya algún problema, llámeme.
a: If there are any problems, please call me.
In the event of a problem, please call me.

items.q: Pongamos que te despiden mañana, ¿qué harías?
items.a: Supposing you lost your job (were fired) tomorrow, what would you do?

items.q: De no ser por tu ayuda, habría suspendido.
a: But for your help, I would have failed.
If it hadn't been for your help, I would have failed.

items.q: Date prisa; si no, perderemos el tren.
items.a: Hurry up; otherwise, we'll miss the train.

items.q: Aunque me ofrecieran el doble, no aceptaría.
items.a: Even if they offered me twice as much, I wouldn't accept.

exercises.title: Lee y contesta
exercises.es: Lee el perfil de esta emprendedora. Marca T o F y contesta las preguntas.
exercises.en: Read the profile. Tick T or F and answer the questions.
text: Fifteen years ago, Clara Méndez was offered two jobs: one at a large bank in Madrid and another at a tiny start-up in Barcelona. She chose the start-up. "If I had accepted the bank's offer, I would probably be a senior manager now," she says, "but I wouldn't be half as happy."

The start-up struggled at first. "But for a loan from my parents, we would have closed in the first year," she admits. Her parents agreed to lend her the money on condition that she finished her master's degree at the same time, which she did.

Today the company employs 200 people, and Clara is generous with advice for young entrepreneurs: "Take risks, as long as you can afford to lose. Always have a plan B in case things go wrong. And unless you truly believe in your product, don't start at all. If I weren't so stubborn, I would have given up a dozen times."

items.q: Clara is now a senior manager at a bank.
Clara thinks she would be happier if she had chosen the bank.
items.why: …but I wouldn't be half as happy.

items.q: Her parents' loan saved the company.
items.why: But for a loan from my parents, we would have closed…

items.q: What condition did her parents set?
items.a: That she finished her master's degree at the same time.

items.q: According to Clara, when should you take risks?
items.a: As long as you can afford to lose.

items.q: Why should you always have a plan B?
Copy the mixed conditional with a permanent condition and a past result.
items.a: If I weren't so stubborn, I would have given up a dozen times.

items.q: Rewrite with if: "But for a loan from my parents, we would have closed in the first year."
items.a: If it hadn't been for a loan from my parents, we would have closed in the first year.

exercises.title: Ahora escribe tú
exercises.es: Escribe frases propias sobre tu vida, tu trabajo o tus estudios.
exercises.en: Write your own sentences about your life, work or studies.

items.q: Una decisión del pasado que afecta a tu presente (If I had…, I would… now).
items.a: Ej.: If I hadn't moved to Madrid, I wouldn't be working for this company now.

items.q: Un rasgo tuyo y una consecuencia pasada (If I were…, I would have…).
items.a: Ej.: If I were more patient, I wouldn't have argued with my boss last week.

items.q: Una norma de tu empresa o centro con provided that o as long as.
items.a: Ej.: Employees can work remotely as long as they attend the weekly meeting.

items.q: Un consejo de viaje con in case y otro con otherwise.
items.a: Ej.: Take a copy of your passport in case you lose it. Book early; otherwise, it will be very expensive.

items.q: Una hipótesis con Supposing… o What if…
items.a: Ej.: Supposing the company closed tomorrow, what would you do?
